assets.caption: EXHIBIT 11-18 Flexibility Check Steps. Composite hand-drawn exhibit with four labeled steps for an expansion-loop flexibility check: STEP I establish potential flexibility problems (plan view of pipe rack with three parallel pipes 10"-CS @ 450 deg, 8"-CS @ 390 deg, 6"-CS @ 350 deg and line branches dropping off); MULTIPLY COEFFICIENT OF EXPANSION x LENGTH OF LINE / STEP II determine line growth for three lines; STEP III determine whether one anchor point will suffice (single line in plan with branch take-offs and an X mark noting 'TRY ANCHOR IN CENTER OF LINE'); STEP IV arrange lines in proper sequence (plan view of three parallel pipes with U-shaped expansion loop centered, anchors at quarter points labeled '1/4 DISTANCE' on each side, with 6", 8", 10" line callouts and note 'LOCATE THE LINE REQUIRING THE LARGEST LOOP ON THE OUTSIDE').
